_upstream.body_excerpt:
Surface MCP server startup errors when preparing cached tool calls

## Why

A cached MCP tool can remain advertised after its server fails to start. Calling it previously returned a generic unavailable-tool error, hiding the startup failure from the model.

## What changed

Propagate preparation errors through MCP tool calls and recorded approval preparation, preserving the error chain and adding the server name to startup failures. Keep the unavailable-tool error for tools that are missing, filtered, or no longer visible to the model.

## Testing

Update the executor capability downgrade test to require the credential resolution startup error in the model's tool output and assert that the host token is absent.
